Package details
Agami SIM Price-100 TK.
Start-up Bonus: Get free 100 minutes, 100 SMS & 5GB data(validity 30 Days days) after activation of Agami SIM .To avail this bonus, customer needs to recharge Tk 100 after activation. Recharge amount will be added to customer main account balance.
Startup bonus offer is one time offer after activation.
The usages validity of startup bonus will be 30 days from the date of Tk.100 recharge.
Recharge bonus offer: by recharging Tk 25, customer will get-25 (On-net) minutes, 25 (On-net) SMS and 50 MB. Validity: 3 days. Tk 25 will be added to subscriber’s main account balance. Subscribers will get this offer once in every  7 days .
After finishing free internet, Pay-Per-Use@1Paisa/15KB will be activated
SMS registration for Agami SIM
Register for Agami SIM from any Teletalk number as per the following SMS Format:- Please type: AGAMI SSC_board (First 03 letters) SSC_Roll SSC_Year Contact_No and send to
16222
. (SMS charges applicable)
Example: AGAMI MYM 123456 2026 0155XXXXXXX
N.B: After successful registration, you will get an ID and OTP. You can withdraw Agami SIM from any Teletalk Customer Care showing this ID, OTP, NID no. and carry copy of SSC Admit Card/Certificate/Marksheet.
